verdict.rationale: LangSmith is a SaaS platform with an API, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair axis. The evidence only shows that an API exists (trace filter/export via the API) and that SDKs exist. Nothing documents API version identifiers, version guarantees, or a deprecation or sunset policy, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
